snippet.description:
Master Conditional Statements, Biconditional Statements, Converse, Inverse, Contrapositive, and Logical Equivalence in Discrete Mathematics with step-by-step truth tables and solved examples.

Iss video lecture mein hum Discrete Mathematics ke important topic Conditional Statements (सह-प्रतिबंधी कथन) aur Biconditional Statements (द्वि-प्रतिबंधी कथन) ko detail mein step-by-step discuss kar rahe hain.

📌 Topics Covered in this Lecture:
✅ What is Conditional Statement / Implication (p → q)
✅ Truth Table construction for Implication
✅ Converse, Inverse & Contrapositive (विलोम, प्रतिलोम एवं प्रतिस्थिति)
✅ Biconditional Statements / Double Implication (p ↔ q)
✅ Concept of Logical Equivalence (तार्किक तुल्यता) with Truth Tables

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS:
00:00 - Introduction & Quick Recap of Connectives
03:40 - Conditional Statements (Implication: p → q)
07:10 - Truth Table for Conditional Statements
11:57 - Example of Conditional Statement
12:25 - Converse, Inverse & Contrapositive Explained
15:02 - Combined Truth Table (Converse, Inverse & Contrapositive)
17:40 - Logical Equivalence of Implication & Contrapositive
19:38 - Biconditional Statements (Double Implication: p ↔ q)
22:48 - Truth Table for Biconditional Statements
26:00 - What is Logical Equivalence? (Definition & Notation)
29:15 - How to Prove Logical Equivalence using Truth Tables
30:35 - Summary & What's Next in the Course

🔔 Don't forget to subscribe to Fractal Frontier Maths for more university math lectures and solved papers.

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics
